name: player_select_best_probes_by_dot_product
description: Player::SelectBestProbesByDotProduct ranks above-ground probe samples by reference-normal dot product and prunes the selected set to a compatible support triple.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the Player environment-probe selector pass so the expanded top-four insertion ladder, x87 compare-status tests, and global flag mutation order can be compared together.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly and MLIL for 0x42cc00 validate scoring enabled samples by dot(referenceNormal, world point with candidateScoreBySample as Y), strict top-four insertion, clearing samples that fall out of the top four, final CheckProbeSampleMaskOverlap on the top three, clearing the fourth-ranked sample when the top three have no shared mask and otherwise clearing the third-ranked sample, then RebuildAboveGroundIndices.
The native smoke verifies both final pruning branches and compacted above-ground index output.
